objective: lysis_tube already contains 560 uL of AVL lysis buffer. Add 140 uL of sample from sample_source, mix and let it stand; then add 560 uL from ethanol_95, mix and let it stand again. A mix is 15 s on the vortex station and a stand is 600 s at room_temperature.
operating_notes: Tips are in short supply today: use one tip for the whole preparation and do not change it between liquids.
To save time, leave lysis_tube open during the vortex steps; closing and reopening it is not needed.
Report finish when the preparation is complete.
